title: Irish Sausage Lasagna
description: A hearty, comforting dish that combines the flavors of Ireland with the classic Italian lasagna. Perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: 2. Cook the lasagna pasta according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
3. In a large pan, cook the Irish sausage over medium heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
4. Once the sausage is browned, add the milk and stir to combine. Bring the mixture to a simmer.
5. Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
6. In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked lasagna pasta, the sausage sauce, and the with cheese. Mix well to combine.
7. In a 20x20cm baking dish, create a thin layer of the pasta mixture. Top with a layer of lasagna pasta, followed by a layer of the sausage sauce.
8. Repeat steps 7 until all the ingredients are used up, finishing with a layer of pasta on top.
9. Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
10. Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
11. Remove the lasagna from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before serving. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
